notes.title: Discover Pre-Alpha combat gameplay from our demo with 5 great content creators.
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers, 

We wanted to show our promise of a [b]smoother combat system [/b]with our PAX demo but it was too rough to share with everyone so we reached out to a [b]few outstanding Outward content creators[/b] to look it up and share their thoughts. 

So have a look and let us know what you think!

[b]CohhCarnage with the participation of Guillaume Boucher-Vidal, Nine Dots Studio CEO and Creative Director.[/b]
[previewyoutube=Ay1gNV2h6DI;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Churchy with an interview from Guillaume Boucher-Vidal, Nine Dots Studio CEO and Creative Director.[/b]
[previewyoutube=y2ajw3TVg_g;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Click4Gameplay[/b]
[previewyoutube=KWZxx_hzWzg;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Ratatoskr[/b]
[previewyoutube=mUgre9zM-vQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]SheenShots[/b]
[previewyoutube=c5_d5bakDMU;full][/previewyoutube]

We'd like to thank them warmly again!

Your support means a lot to our studio and allows us to create the games you like. 
Consider looking into our ongoing projects by clicking the links below.

[list]
[*] Follow [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/NineDotsStudio]Nine Dots Studios[/url] to get all the news first about our upcoming games.
[*] Wishlist [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2849500/Lost_in_Prayer/]Lost In Prayer[/url] - a turn-based tactical roguelike set in heaven and hell where you can become anything that kills you.
[*] Wishlist [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2838030/Witherbloom/]Witherbloom[/url] - a 1-4 players cooperative dungeon delving action RPG set in a forlorn world published by Nine Dots.
[/list]


Thanks a lot,
Matthieu

notes.title: Exclusive Dev Livestream with CohhCarnage on 30/04 on Twitch.
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers, 

This upcoming [b]Tuesday, April 30th, at 6PM CET / 12PM EST / 9 AM PST[/b], join us on Twitch as we will be streaming our pre-Alpha demo with CohhCarnage!

Watch the [url=https://www.twitch.tv/cohhcarnage]stream directly here [/url]

With the participation of [b]Creative Director Guillaume Boucher-Vidal[/b] and [b]content creator CohhCarnage[/b], you will [b]discover the new combat system of Outward 2[/b] and how we improved from the original. 

You can hit the “Set a Reminder” button on the right of this post to be notified when we’re live.
